# Zerro

> **Talk to your screen. Zerro does the work.** A lightweight macOS menu bar app. Record your screen, explain what you want, and get it done faster. Zerro turns a screen recording and spoken instructions into exactly what you need: an agent prompt, a ready-to-send message, a code or spreadsheet snippet, a written-up document, or a clear answer to your question. Frame a region of your screen, dictate what you want, and Zerro puts ready-to-use text on your clipboard. Paste it into Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or any tool that takes text, or send it to a person. Zerro is open source and bring-your-own-key: your Mac prepares the recording, transcribes your narration (locally by default, or directly with OpenAI on your own key), and runs best-effort secret redaction, then sends the prepared frames and transcript straight to your AI provider (OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic) on your own key. Zerro never receives recordings, frames, audio, transcripts, prompts, or results, and no account is required.

Zerro is built for anyone who would rather talk through what they want than type it out: handing a coding agent real context, drafting a message about what's on screen, grabbing the exact formula or snippet, turning messy notes into a clean write-up, or getting a confusing screen explained. You speak roughly 4× faster than you type; Zerro closes that gap by capturing what's on screen alongside what you say.

## How it works

- Hit the hotkey and drag to frame the part of your screen Zerro should see.
- Dictate what you want in plain language, up to 3 minutes per recording.
- Zerro prepares and transcribes the recording on your Mac, then sends the frames and transcript in a single API call on your own key.
- Ready-to-use text lands on your clipboard: the artifact that fits what you asked for (an agent prompt, a message, a snippet, a document) or a plain-language answer.

## Key facts

- Platform: native macOS app (Swift & SwiftUI, built on ScreenCaptureKit). Not Electron.
- Processing: local-first, meaning your recording is prepared on your machine.
- Keys: bring your own OpenAI, Gemini & Anthropic keys, stored in the macOS Keychain. You pay your provider directly for usage.
- Recording cap: 3 minutes per recording, for fast and predictable cost.
- Distribution: signed & notarized .dmg, with Sparkle auto-updates.
- Free trial: the first time an official build runs on a Mac it begins a 14-day free trial (reinstalling does not reset it). No card, no account; you need your own provider API key.
- Pricing: a Zerro license is $39 one-time. It activates on up to 2 Macs at once and includes all Zerro 1.x.x updates; a future 2.0 major release may be sold separately. No subscription, no Zerro account.
- Open source: Zerro is free software under GPL-3.0-or-later, official builds included. Build it yourself and no Zerro license is required; the $39 pays for the official signed and notarized build, its 1.x.x update service, and support, and doesn't buy or limit any GPL right.
